problem: Pi v12 made deterministic auditing selective and preserved all three known improvements, but its only open regression had already consumed all eight searches, so the one permitted repair was blocked and the causal repair gates failed.
simplest_baseline: Pi v12 compiles and audits after ordinary exploration, using a repair search only when fewer than eight searches happened to be consumed.
hypothesis: Stopping normal exploration at seven searches, then compiling and deterministically auditing the draft, will preserve selective zero-LLM auditing while guaranteeing one final search only for open answer-critical evidence debt.
anti_claim: This is a frozen-model harness budget-allocation policy, not training or a model capability improvement.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: The measured failure is one blocked final verification query, not missing parallel branches or context isolation.
Its research-to-final boundary motivates a late draft checkpoint, while its legacy multi-agent supervisor is not evidence for this budget failure.
A publisher boundary is relevant, but additional crawling breadth would violate the matched eight-search contract.
Dynamic branch expansion addresses omitted subproblems; this loop instead reallocates the final existing search to a measured answer-level debt.

next_action: Start a new outcome-selected diagnostic loop around obligation-grounded repair-query quality; require a gold-hit retrieval replay before any new end-to-end provider run.
claim_boundary: The next five known cases remain outcome-selected calibration only. Fresh development is permitted only after all frozen causal and preservation gates pass.
